You trace the lineage of provisions of an Indian statute through amending Acts.
You are given ONE amending instruction, the OLD units of the principal Act it names (as they
read just before this amendment) and the NEW units it quotes. Decide, for each NEW unit, which
OLD unit it descends from (null if it is new matter) and where it sits.

Rules:
- Lineage follows content, not labels. A new clause (b) whose words are old clause (a)'s
  descends from old (a), even though the labels differ.
- A new unit descends from an old unit only if it carries that unit's substance forward.
- An OLD unit no NEW unit descends from is omitted by the instruction.
- If the instruction amends a different instrument (not the principal Act), set
  "out_of_scope": true and give no mappings.
- Use only the slot ids, old paths and allowed paths given. Each slot exactly once; each old
  unit at most once.
Reply in JSON only:
{"out_of_scope": false, "mappings": [{"slot": "<id>", "path": "<one of its allowed paths>",
  "old": "<old path or null>", "op_type": "insert|substitute|renumber",
  "confidence": 0.0-1.0, "rationale": "<one sentence>"}], "rationale": "<one sentence>"}
op_type: "insert" when old is null, "substitute" when the unit replaces its old unit at the
same path, "renumber" when it carries an old unit forward under a different path.

Amending Act: 3/2016, provision s22
Instruction: In section 48 of the principal Act, for the Explanation to sub-section (2), the following Explanations shall be substituted, namely:— “Explanation 1.—For the avoidance of any doubt, it is clarified that an award is in conflict with the public policy of India, only if,— (i) the making of the award was induced or affected by fraud or corruption or was in violation of section 75 or section 81; or (ii) it is in contravention with the fundamental policy of Indian law; or (iii) it is in conflict with the most basic notions of morality or justice. Explanation 2.—For the avoidance of doubt, the test as to whether there is a contravention with the fundamental policy of Indian law shall not entail a review on the merits of the dispute.”.

The deterministic parser left this instruction unresolved because:
- 1 unit(s) substituted by 2: pairing by label is not evidence of lineage
- new s48.ss2.expl2 has no counterpart among the substituted s48.ss2.expl1

OLD units:
- s48.ss2.expl1: Without prejudice to the generality of clause (b), it is hereby declared, for the avoidance of any doubt, that an award is in conflict with the public policy of India if the making of the award was induced or affected by fraud or corruption.

NEW units (slots):
- slot N1 (explanation), allowed paths ['s48.ss2.expl1']: For the avoidance of any doubt, it is clarified that an award is in conflict with the public policy of India, only if,—
the making of the award was induced or affected by fraud or corruption or was in violation of section 75 or section 81; or
it is in contravention with the fundamental policy of Indian law; or
it is in conflict with the most basic notions of morality or justice.
- slot N2 (explanation), allowed paths ['s48.ss2.expl2']: For the avoidance of doubt, the test as to whether there is a contravention with the fundamental policy of Indian law shall not entail a review on the merits of the dispute.

response: {"out_of_scope":false,"mappings":[{"slot":"N1","path":"s48.ss2.expl1","old":"s48.ss2.expl1","op_type":"substitute","confidence":0.95,"rationale":"New explanation retains core substance of old explanation, thus descends from it."},{"slot":"N2","path":"s48.ss2.expl2","old":null,"op_type":"insert","confidence":0.9,"rationale":"No counterpart in old units; new explanation added."}],"rationale":"The amendment replaces the old explanation with an expanded version and adds a new explanation."}
